t.E528.agn: In 1965, JECFA set the ADI for magnesium hydroxide as 'not limited'; the evaluation stated that no toxicological reason was seen to limit use in line with good manufacturing practice, but that the total magnesium intake from these additives should be kept in mind from a nutritional point of view. In the EU it is a Group I additive; EFSA's re-evaluation has not yet been published (it was included in a call for data in 2016).
t.E528.found.0: May be used at quantum satis (as much as needed) in many foods in the EU
t.E528.prod: It is obtained by precipitation through adding sodium hydroxide to soluble magnesium salts, or by reacting magnesium oxide with water.
t.E528.regx.1: Group I additive; generally permitted at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E528.regx.2: Included in the call for use/concentration data as part of the re-evaluation (deadline 31.01.2017).
t.E528.summary: Magnesium hydroxide. Used as an acidity regulator.
t.E528.what: It is a base used to regulate acidity and to neutralise. In food it reacts with acids to form magnesium salts.
